name: Off-Road Vehicle
description: A self-propelled vehicle designed or adapted for cross-country travel, including the motorized trail bike, a two- or three-wheeler built solely for use off the roadway; an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria is one.

restrictions.rule: Includes all-terrain vehicles, utility-terrain vehicles and motorized trail bikes; snowmobiles, personal mobility devices and electric power-assisted cycles are excluded
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 1

restrictions.rule: No limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Riders and passengers under 16 must wear a prescribed helmet at all times, anywhere
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, ss. 217.06 and 217.08

restrictions.rule: Within a maintained roadway it's treated as a motor vehicle: the rider needs an operator's licence, the Act's registration and insurance rules apply, and rider and passenger must wear a prescribed helmet
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, ss. 217.02, 217.03 and 217.07

restrictions.rule: On a maintained roadway it rides as near as practicable to the right edge, single file, with only as many passengers as it's designed for
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 217.04

restrictions.rule: The 2021 Off-Road Vehicle Management Area Regulation restricts its use in designated areas, starting with alpine areas, part of the Peel watershed and the Ddhaw Ghro Habitat Protection Area
Not a motor cycle, which must be designed for the roadway
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 1
